title: Killing is Shaytan’s Forbidden, Cursed Teaching
body:
Suhbah After Salaat al-Jumu`ah
Yaa RijaalAllah, madad. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahuma salli wa sallim wa baarik `alaa afdali ‘l-khalqi, ashrafi ‘lkhalq habeebi ‘l-Rabbi ’l-`alameen rasoolu ’th-thaqalayn Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Thumma ‘s-salaatu wa ’s-salaam `alaa jam`iyy’il-anbiyaa wa’ lmursaleen wa `alaa `ibaadAllahi ‘s-saaliheen wa ‘l-Aqtaab, wa ’l-Awtaad, wa ’l-Akhyaar, wa ’l-Budalaa, wa ’nNujabaa, wa ’n-Nuqabaa. Yaa RijaalAllah amidoona bi madadikum salaamullahi `alaykum yaa Sayyidee yaa
Sultan al-Awliyaa, Shaykh `AbdAllah al-Fa`iz ad-Daghestani madad! Madad yaa RijaalAllah!
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Salaamullah to our attenders
through the east and west.
O People! You and all of us are servants. Don't forget that death is following you like your shadow and when it
comes, your soul will be taken away. Don't be arrogant and don't forget that we are not for dunya, we are for
Eternity! Always say, “A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem,” and run away from Shaytan, the worst
creature, because he is going to cheat you, saying, “You must live as you like.” But your life is a very short

time and the Seal of Prophets (s) said, “The age of my nation is between 60 and 70 and then they will be
taken away.” People are following Shaytan and not following the commands of Heavens, while the Heavens
and heavenly ones call people to worship!
Shaytan is cheating you and the unbelievers, reaching people up until today, trying to make his hegemony on
all of Mankind! I am sorry to say that we reached the time when all of the world's people are following
Shaytan, leaving the prophets' safe ways that lead them to Paradise, to Jannat al-Firdaus. One command
from Shaytan to Mankind is, "Die, kill, and murder! You may kill as much as you are able, and also prepare to
die!" From east to west and north to south, this is Shaytan's order, and shame on Mankind for carrying it out,
for very carefully trying to fulfill that order by killing themselves and others everywhere!
O Our Attenders! That is a shaytanic teaching, and everywhere there is fire and people killing each other. The
Lord of Heavens is sending warnings, like a tsunami, earthquake or hurricane, but people are not taking care
that He is not happy with what we are doing. He Almighty forbids people, saying, "Don't kill!" but people are
running after Shaytan. If someone kills, his punishment is that he will remain in the Fire forever, and yet
people are still killing. Keep yourselves! Life is a grant to us from the Lord of Heavens! O Murderers, who is
giving to you the authority to kill? Allah (swt) says, "Don't kill," and for those who kill, He is taking His
revenge on them from now until forever.
I am sorry to say that every day in Pakistan, Muslims are killing each other with bombs. What is that
foolishness; are there no `ulama there to teach them? And secondly, the Arabs are doing it. Where does it say
in our holy books to do that? Allah (swt) is telling us to be happy, and He will take His revenge on people.
Who are they to say, "Someone will come to kill you in the worst way." Laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. Madad, yaa Sayyidee! O our Lord! Send us a sultan to lead us to fulfill Your orders, to
make people Your servants and not servants of Shaytan, because from east to west, north to south, slavery to
Shaytan is bringing us to the worst and lowest level!
O People! We are calling the Egyptian, Syrian, Lebanese and Libyan people and all people in the Muslim
territories, to recite Holy Qur'an and think about it. If I am wrong correct me, and if I am right, correct
yourselves. We hope that Allah Almighty will send a sultan with a sultanate, and He will order him to be
ameer in Egypt, Turkey, Libya and everywhere. We hope the Sultan al- Mu'mineen is coming; he is

authorized through His Lion, the Ottomans, and he must come and welcome Imam al Mahdi (a) in Istanbul.
But the price to reach these holy days is that millions of people will be taken away. If they don’t come under
heavenly protection they will be taken away, even if they were on Earth for a million years! Billions--those
who are with Shaytan and those who run after him--will be taken away to the Fire!
O People! Ask forgiveness from your Lord! Ask for divine protection for the Believers. Leftist leaders will be
taken to divine punishment. That is enough of being drunk! Come back to yourselves and see reality! If not, I
am asking for forgiveness for myself, for you and for all the believers, because if we are not asking for
forgiveness, mercy will never come. Ask for blessings and forgiveness so that the blessings can come to you.
Tawbah yaa Rabbee, astaghfirullah! Tawbah yaa Rabbee, astaghfirullah! Tawbah yaa Rabbee, astaghfirullah!
Yaa Rabbanaa! Send us someone who will save Your weak servants from the hands of Shaytan and its
followers. Yaa Allah! We are weak servants. This is Safar al-khayr, and whatever is good comes down on
believers in this month, and heavenly mightiness will come on the unbelievers in this month!
O People! Say shahadah three times:
Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasooluh.
Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasooluh.
Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasooluh.
O our Lord! Forgive us and send someone to us from Your private and chosen people who can keep Your
weak servants from falling into hells. Save us! O our Lord, save us! Tawbah yaa Rabbee! Tawbah yaa Rabbee!
We are weak servants. Take away Shaytan's followers who lead people to the Fire, and send us powerful,
enlightened ones, heavenly protected people to save us, for the sake of Your Most Beloved One, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Don't make trouble among Muslims by saying, "We are Wahabi, Salafi (or of some different sect).” Try to be
obedient servants to our Lord, Who created us and sent the beloved Prophet, the Highest One in the Divine

Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
al-Fatihah. Allah!
(Baya`)
